lines: This tiny engine beats an 8B-parameter LLM. And it's 11× faster.
OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system. It turns your AI coding assistant into a full studio.
Starting from a reference video you love is often faster than starting blank. The agent analyzes pacing and hook style automatically.
OpenMontage uses an **agent-first architecture** with 100+ registered production tools. Every major choice runs through a strict scoring engine for quality and cost.
You don't need paid API keys to make real videos with offline narration. Human approval gates are enforced at every stage to ensure safety.
